description:
Activate Taii Wakeen by paying {1} and tapping it, increasing the amount of damage sources you control deal this turn by 1.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2 as desired.

uses.name: Triskelion
uses.cardState: with at least one +1/+1 counter on it
